title: Maps from a finitely presented algebra into a filtered colimit factor through a stage
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $J$ a small filtered category, $j\mapsto B_j$ a functor from $J$ to commutative $R$-algebras ($R$-algebra transition maps), and $(\Lambda,(\iota_j)_j)$ a colimit of this diagram in the category of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] such that $\Lambda$ is an $R$-algebra and every $\iota_j:B_j\to\Lambda$ is a homomorphism of $R$-algebras. Let $C=R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]/(f_1,\ldots,f_m)$ with $f_1,\ldots,f_m\in R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ (a finitely presented $R$-algebra), and let $g:C\to\Lambda$ be a homomorphism of $R$-algebras. Then there are $j\in J$ and a homomorphism of $R$-algebras $g':C\to B_j$ with $\iota_j\circ g'=g$.
